Most importantly, he is already at re:cinq working on AI agent infrastructure and MCP—directly aligned with a key emerging requirement. While Nest.js and Vitest are not explicitly mentioned in his resume, his deep architectural thinking, multi-language proficiency, and demonstrated ability to master new frameworks positions him to ramp up quickly on framework-specific details.

Strong foundation in primary stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React) with demonstrated testing discipline and TDD practices throughout career
